entities.name: Ursal Daleel
entities.description: Ambassador of Suderbod in Berimish, a scheming manipulator with the title Archval.

entities.name: Tagard Tarngold
entities.description: Leader whose forces took over Berimish.

entities.name: Bey Lisolo
entities.description: Viashino ruler whose amulet of leadership Tagard claimed.

entities.name: Aligarius Timni
entities.description: Wizard manipulated by Ursal with addictive honey-laced food.

entities.name: Karelon
entities.description: Conspired with Ursal to have the king assassinated.

entities.name: Hemarch Solin
entities.description: Ruler of Suderbod, killed after Ursal tricked Recin and Kitrin into conflict with him.

entities.name: Recin
entities.description: Fought Ursal and drowned him in the bayou.

entities.name: Kitrin
entities.description: Ally of Recin tricked by Ursal into conflict with Solin.

entities.name: Magewall Hub
entities.description: Device stolen from the Institute of Arcane Study.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: Place the Magewall Hub was stolen from.

events.summary: Ursal opens the Berimish palace doors to Tagard Tarngold's invaders and lets him claim Bey Lisolo's amulet.
events.quote: Ursal opened the doors for the invaders and allowed Tagard to claim Bey Lisolo 's amulet of leadership.

events.summary: Ursal manipulates Aligarius Timni with food laced with addictive honey.
events.quote: Ursal later manipulated the wizard Aligarius Timni with food laced with mind-altering honey

events.summary: Ursal kills the king with a crossbow bolt using a talisman forged by Aligarius.
events.quote: allowed Ursal himself to kill the king with a crossbow bolt

events.summary: Ursal tricks Recin and Kitrin into a conflict that ends with Hemarch Solin killed.
events.quote: managed to trick Recin and Kitrin into a personal conflict with the ruler, which ended with Solin being killed.

events.summary: Aligarius dazzles Ursal with a light ball and Recin and Kitrin knock him out.
events.quote: Aligarius managed to snap out of his addiction just enough to dazzle Ursal with a light ball

events.summary: Recin pulls Ursal underwater in the bayou and he is drowned and eaten by an attalo.
events.quote: Recin pulled him underwater, and he was drowned, then eaten by an attalo .

relations.quote: Ursal Daleel was the ambassador of Suderbod
